title: Reports of Cruelty to Community Animals and Measures to Safeguard Welfare of These Animals
what_it_is: Reports of Cruelty to Community Animals and Measures to Safeguard Welfare of These Animals

sections.label: Reviewing Animals and Birds Act penalties
sections.summary: Two cases were referred for prosecution, and the ABA is being reviewed to enhance enforcement powers and strengthen penalties for animal welfare offences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Two cases were referred for prosecution during this period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To ensure that the Animals and Birds Act (ABA) remains effective in deterring animal cruelty and abuse, we are reviewing the ABA to enhance enforcement powers and strengthen the penalty framework for animal welfare offences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This includes reviewing imprisonment terms and disqualification orders for both first-time and repeat offences.
